hyperedges.label: Core loop: library -> plan -> session -> widget

nodes.label: AppColors colour tokens (light/dark)
nodes.rationale: One cobalt button per screen; yellow means only 'you beat last time'; WCAG AA body contrast.

nodes.label: Global style (Material 3, cobalt brand, DM Sans)
nodes.norm_label: global style (material 3, cobalt brand, dm sans)

nodes.label: Firebase (Firestore + Auth)
nodes.rationale: Chosen over SQL: same flow as shelf_snap, offline cache for gym and widget use, document-shaped data, no DB hosting.

nodes.label: Firestore -> Repository (watchX) -> Riverpod (currentUidProvider) -> Screen data flow
nodes.norm_label: firestore -> repository (watchx) -> riverpod (currentuidprovider) -> screen data flow

nodes.label: GSD Workflow Enforcement
nodes.rationale: File-changing work must start through a GSD command (/gsd-fast, /gsd-quick, /gsd-debug, /gsd-execute-phase) so planning artifacts and execution context stay in sync.

nodes.label: Offline-first behaviour (poor gym signal)
nodes.rationale: Gyms often have poor signal, so plan, last-session data and widget must work offline.

nodes.label: shelf_snap code conventions
nodes.rationale: Repwise copies shelf_snap's lib/core + lib/features layout, snake_case role-suffixed files, immutable fromMap/toMap models, AppColors-only colours, absolute imports.

nodes.label: Active session state in home_widget shared storage
nodes.norm_label: active session state in home_widget shared storage
nodes.rationale: Native widget must read/write session state offline, not only via Firestore cache.

nodes.label: Out of Scope (guest mode, iOS v1, Play Store v1, Drive, SQL, social, direct AI calls)
nodes.norm_label: out of scope (guest mode, ios v1, play store v1, drive, sql, social, direct ai calls)

nodes.label: Platform requirements (PLAT-01 iOS, PLAT-02 Play Store, v2)
nodes.norm_label: platform requirements (plat-01 ios, plat-02 play store, v2)

nodes.label: Plan: edit a day screen
nodes.rationale: Weight is not set in the plan because it comes from last time.

nodes.label: Workout logging screen (core screen, Last time column)
nodes.norm_label: workout logging screen (core screen, last time column)

nodes.label: Repwise Roadmap (6 vertical MVP phases)
nodes.rationale: Each vertical slice ships to real users through the OTA pipeline; core loop before extras.

nodes.label: Core Value: see current exercise and last time, log, move on
nodes.norm_label: core value: see current exercise and last time, log, move on
nodes.rationale: At the gym the user must see current exercise and last lift, log it, and advance, ideally from the home-screen widget.

nodes.label: home_widget background interactivity research
nodes.rationale: Add set / mark done from the widget need background callbacks while the app is closed.

nodes.label: Rest timer built with session engine (Phase 3)
nodes.norm_label: rest timer built with session engine (phase 3)
nodes.rationale: So the widget (WIDG-04) only has to mirror it.

nodes.label: AI proxy: Groq first, Gemini fallback
nodes.norm_label: ai proxy: groq first, gemini fallback
nodes.rationale: Keeps API keys out of the APK; Groq free tier for cost; single place to switch providers.

nodes.label: Cloudinary GIF hosting
nodes.rationale: CDN delivery and GIF to MP4/WebP conversion; Google Drive rejected as unreliable for hotlinking.

nodes.label: Express backend (admin panel + AI proxy)
nodes.rationale: Server-rendered HTML writing via firebase-admin; no separate SPA; admin bypasses client rules safely; also proxies AI so keys stay out of the APK.

nodes.label: Library seeded from open dataset (free-exercise-db)
nodes.rationale: Avoids hand-entering hundreds of exercises; admin curates afterwards.

nodes.label: free-exercise-db ships JPG stills, not GIFs
nodes.norm_label: free-exercise-db ships jpg stills, not gifs

nodes.label: Settings screen (theme, unit, rest timer, update)
nodes.norm_label: settings screen (theme, unit, rest timer, update)

nodes.label: OTA updates via ota_update + GitHub Releases
nodes.norm_label: ota updates via ota_update + github releases
nodes.rationale: Fastest path to production; Android-only; Play Store deferred.

nodes.label: Design goal: one thing per screen
nodes.norm_label: design goal: one thing per screen
nodes.rationale: Used between sets with sweaty thumbs and seconds of attention; each screen answers one question with one main button.

nodes.label: Release keystore backup risk
nodes.rationale: Losing the one persistent signing key breaks OTA updates for every installed user (REL-03).

nodes.label: Assets needed (icon, logo, body outline SVG, widget preview)
nodes.norm_label: assets needed (icon, logo, body outline svg, widget preview)

nodes.label: Per-session summary fields
nodes.rationale: Lets stats work without heavy Firestore aggregation queries.
